subject: Fellow Conservative, I refuse to stay silent
body:
What happened to me in the pool was only the beginning of my fight.

View in Web Browser
[https://link.email.america1stwarroom.com/click/e6180424/UaHR0cHM6Ly93cm8ubnVjbGV1c2VtYWlsLmNvbS9hbXBsaWZ5L3YvNUJQWk1uY3RDWg/SZW1haWxfYW1lcmljYU9ORXN0d2Fycm9vbV9jb20yNjEwMDg/LbmNseWdCU1J6bg/qP2hpZHM9bmMwWnJTM0JiSEJYNnhsc10/gasfDJQ/s9o24b9aec0

[https://link.email.america1stwarroom.

Dear Fellow Conservative,

Even though we don’t know each other yet, I’m writing to ask you
to stand beside me at the top of a very slippery slope.

Actually, in my case, it’s a slippery slide.

Because my name is Riley Gaines and I’m the University of Kentucky
swimmer who had to compete against a fully intact 6’4” male
swimmer dressed in a women’s bathing suit.

And after he stole the victory I had worked for my entire life, I had
to go back to the women’s locker room and undress out of my wet
bathing suit while he did the same next to me.

Maybe you want to stop reading right now.

I know the images I’m bringing up are horrible.

But please don’t stop.

Because God-fearing, faith-filled people like you and me have a job to
do today.

We can’t retreat into our homes and hope President Trump will fix
everything and the Left’s evil culture will just pass us by.

That’s why I’m asking you to give in the next 48 hours.

My fellow conservative, you know this slippery slide.

It’s the same one you got pushed down when the Left told you
abortion was going to be “safe, legal, and rare.” Now abortion is
a “right” and “women’s healthcare.” And if you don’t
support it up until the moment of birth, you must “hate women.”

It’s the same slippery slide you got pushed down when the Left told
you limiting gay couples to civil unions was “mean.” You were
told, “They just want to use the word “marriage” like everyone
else. It’s just a word.” Now if you don’t fully embrace the
homosexual lifestyle by displaying rainbows and celebrating gay pride,
you’re a “hate-filled bigot.”

Enough with their lies. We have Truth on our side. And we need to
start acting like it.

God created man. And God created woman.

It isn’t any more complicated than that.

Letting men believe they are women... letting girls believe they are
boys... is a bold-faced rejection of God’s truth.

President Trump is fighting these lies with temporary Executive
Orders. But radical courts are already undermining him. We must stop
this deranged movement from gaining one more inch.

We’ve got to counter them in the courts or rogue judges will rule
that kids can be taken away from parents who oppose this evil... that
schools can hide “transition” from parents... and that doctors can
mutilate children with no consequences.

Your chance is right now – and right by my side.

Please stand with me against the radical transgender movement by
making a gift in the next 48 hours.

YES, I’LL STAND WITH RILEY
[https://link.email.america1stwarroom.

Please don’t tell me, “Riley, this isn’t a widespread
problem.”

Look at this photo.

[Lavine and Brinton]
[https://link.email.america1stwarroom.

This is pediatrician, 4-star admiral, and former Assistant Secretary
for Health -- Rachel Levine (born Richard Levine). This man in a
women’s Navy uniform has been a “leader” in your government.

And the person standing next to Levine? That’s Sam Brinton. He’s a
man in a dress who was a Biden-Harris nuclear official until he got
caught stealing luggage at Ronald Reagan Airport filled with ladies
clothes.

Then consider that 11 states and counting, plus the District of
Columbia, are transgender “sanctuary” states. That means in some
of them, minor children can flee there and get transgender services --
even sex change operations -- without their parents’ permission.

And did you know Medicare now covers sex change operations?

It just goes on and on... This evil is widespread.

Or maybe you’re thinking like so many, “Riley, adults are free to
do whatever they want. And children should be kept away from this evil
by their parents.”

As for the transgender adults, your generation used to call these
people perverts, predators, and pedophiles.

Should they be representing our government? Alone in classrooms with
our children?

And as for parents, I agree this problem would have less traction if
parents just said, “No.”

But parents in Maryland had their child taken away because they
refused to let their son transition to a “girl.”

Parents in states like Vermont and Colorado saw their foster care
licenses revoked because they admitted they would not help a child who
may be assigned to their home get puberty blockers or have sex change
surgery.

Parents in California got themselves elected to the school board,
passed guidelines to protect their children from the transgender
movement, and now the state of California is suing them.

Even with President Trump’s temporary Executive Orders attempting to
ban men from women’s sports and bathrooms, and halt grotesque
medical procedures for children... you can see, the radical
transgender movement has parents backed into a corner.

I’m sorry I’ve gone on so long detailing the transgender threat.
But when I’m speaking around the country, I meet so many seniors who
say, “I wish someone had told me about this sooner.”

But the good news is that right now, you still have a chance to help
stop the radical transgender movement before they push us down their
slippery slide.

And today I’m writing you on behalf of a group that is doing more
work to block the transgender movement than anyone I know.

It’s the legal non-profit the CENTER FOR AMERICAN LIBERTY.

YES, I’LL STAND WITH RILEY
[https://link.email.america1stwarroom.

And your gift is going straight to help them.

With the help of patriots like you, the CENTER FOR AMERICAN LIBERTY
fights the transgender movement in the courts because that’s the
only way to stop them.

And the CENTER FOR AMERICAN LIBERTY is attacking this evil from all
sides with their comprehensive three-pronged approach.

#1. THEY’RE FIGHTING RADICAL SCHOOLS.

I know it may sound crazy to you but in today’s taxpayer-funded
schools, teachers, and counselors encourage young children to socially
“transition” at school and then facilitate the “transition” by
giving children new names and even giving them new clothes so they can
dress as the opposite sex.

And they keep it all a secret from parents!

You probably remember a time when kids needed a note from home just to
get an aspirin at school!

The CENTER FOR AMERICAN LIBERTY is taking these radicals to court in
multiple cases. And they already have one major win!

When you give, you’re making sure PARENTS have the final word in
guiding their children -- not school radicals!

#2. THEY’RE FIGHTING RADICAL DOCTORS.

My fellow conservative, I hope you love and trust your doctors. There
are lots of good ones out there.

But there are also doctors who mutilate children for profit in the
name of transgender “care.” They use their “expertise” to
convince even conservative parents that if they oppose
“transition,” their child will commit suicide.

Then these doctors pump children full of dangerous puberty blockers
and perform gruesome surgeries to remove children’s healthy breasts
and other parts.

Again, I apologize for the graphic description, but this is the pure
evil we’re facing.

Maybe you’ve seen a girl named Chloe Cole on Fox News. In a landmark
case, the CENTER FOR AMERICAN LIBERTY is helping her sue the radical
doctors and hospital that gave her a double mastectomy at age 15.

President Trump signed an Executive Order aimed at protecting children
from these grotesque doctors but a Biden-appointed federal judge has
already blocked its enforcement.

The best way to protect children is to contribute to help Chloe and
the CENTER FOR AMERICAN LIBERTY win their case to make sure this never
happens to another child!

#3. THEY’RE FIGHTING FOR YOUR RIGHT TO SPEAK OUT AGAINST THIS
HEINOUS EVIL.

You’ll be happy to know that fighting for Freedom of Speech is one
of the CENTER FOR AMERICAN LIBERTY’S specialties.

They’ve notched plenty of victories in this space including fighting
for an 82-year-old grandmother who got banned for life from the YMCA.

This grandma raised the alarm that a grown man dressed in a women’s
bathing suit was in the women’s locker room “helping” two little
girls get ready to use the bathroom.

And she was the one punished!

But thanks to supporters just like you, the CENTER FOR AMERICAN
LIBERTY fought back and won! And when you give, you’re helping them
win all their critical cases confronting the evil of the transgender
movement.

YES, I’LL STAND WITH RILEY
[https://link.email.america1stwarroom.

I know you’d probably love to fund an entire court case on your own
after all I’ve told you, but all I’m asking you to do is RENEW
YOUR SUPPORT with a tax-deductible gift of $30, $50, $75, $100 or even
$250 or more.

Please donate whatever amount is right for you whether it’s smaller
or larger. The CENTER FOR AMERICAN LIBERTY needs and appreciates
every dollar that comes in.

And because I believe so strongly in the work they’re doing – and
because they are one of the few groups who’ve stood
shoulder-to-shoulder with me in this fight...

It will be my honor to send you my new book “Swimming Against the
Current: Fighting for Common Sense in a World That’s Lost Its
Mind” as my free gift when you donate $50 or more to the CENTER FOR
AMERICAN LIBERTY.

[Lavine and Brinton]
[https://link.email.america1stwarroom.

YES, I’LL STAND WITH RILEY
[https://link.email.america1stwarroom.

Before I go, please let me share one last thought with you.

Every morning as a competitive swimmer, I would get up and think of
this verse:

_For I consider that the sufferings of the present time are not worthy
to be compared to the glory that is about to be revealed to us._
(Romans 8:18)

I applied it to my swimming: work hard now and wins come later. But
now I see that God has a much bigger plan for my life just as He does
for yours.

This battle isn’t about a swimming victory. It’s about Kingdom
victory. I will never stop fighting to protect God’s Truth and I
think you feel the same way.

Thank you for reading my letter all the way to the end. I’m praying
for you, and I hope you’ll pray for me too.

Sincerely,

Riley Gaines

P.S. I’m so grateful that President Trump signed temporary Executive
Orders aimed at stopping the radical transgender movement. But the
Left is launching attacks in the courts to undermine him and we must
fight back.

God made man and God made woman. The attempts to deny those basic
truths, are attempts to deny the truth of God.

Your help is so critical to the CENTER FOR AMERICAN LIBERTY’S work,
when you donate $50 or more, as my personal “Thank You,” I’ll
send you my new book, “Swimming Against the Current: Fighting for
Common Sense in a World That’s Lost Its Mind” for free. Please
hurry. It’s getting hard to hold back this evil without you. I
don’t want you to look back a year from now and say, “I wish I had
done something when I had the chance.”

SUPPORT CENTER FOR AMERICAN LIBERTY
[https://link.email.america1stwarroom.

The Center for American Liberty is a 501(c)(3) nonprofit charitable
organization fighting against growing anti-free speech and anti-civil
liberties trends. Your gift is tax-deductible.

And after he stole the victory I had worked for my entire life, I had to go back to the women’s locker room and undress out of my wet bathing suit while he did the same next to me. Maybe you want to stop reading right now. I know the images I’m bringing up are horrible. But please don’t stop. Because God-fearing, faith-filled people like you and me have a job to do today. We can’t retreat into our homes and hope President Trump will fix everything and the Left’s evil culture will just pass us by. That’s why I’m asking you to give in the next 48 hours. My fellow conservative, you know this slippery slide. It’s the same one you got pushed down when the Left told you abortion was going to be “safe, legal, and rare.” Now abortion is a “right” and “women’s healthcare.” And if you don’t support it up until the moment of birth, you must “hate women.” It’s the same slippery slide you got pushed down when the Left told you limiting gay couples to civil unions was “mean.” You were told, “They just want to use the word “marriage” like everyone else. It’s just a word.” Now if you don’t fully embrace the homosexual lifestyle by displaying rainbows and celebrating gay pride, you’re a “hate-filled bigot.” Enough with their lies. We have Truth on our side. And we need to start acting like it. God created man. And God created woman. It isn’t any more complicated than that. Letting men believe they are women... letting girls believe they are boys... is a bold-faced rejection of God’s truth. President Trump is fighting these lies with temporary Executive Orders. But radical courts are already undermining him. We must stop this deranged movement from gaining one more inch. We’ve got to counter them in the courts or rogue judges will rule that kids can be taken away from parents who oppose this evil... that schools can hide “transition” from parents... and that doctors can mutilate children with no consequences. Your chance is right now – and right by my side. Please stand with me against the radical transgender movement by making a gift in the next 48 hours. YES, I’LL STAND WITH RILEY [ Please don’t tell me, “Riley, this isn’t a widespread problem.” Look at this photo. [Lavine and Brinton] [ This is pediatrician, 4-star admiral, and former Assistant Secretary for Health -- Rachel Levine (born Richard Levine). This man in a women’s Navy uniform has been a “leader” in your government. And the person standing next to Levine? That’s Sam Brinton. He’s a man in a dress who was a Biden-Harris nuclear official until he got caught stealing luggage at Ronald Reagan Airport filled with ladies clothes. Then consider that 11 states and counting, plus the District of Columbia, are transgender “sanctuary” states. That means in some of them, minor children can flee there and get transgender services -- even sex change operations -- without their parents’ permission. And did you know Medicare now covers sex change operations? It just goes on and on... This evil is widespread. Or maybe you’re thinking like so many, “Riley, adults are free to do whatever they want. And children should be kept away from this evil by their parents.” As for the transgender adults, your generation used to call these people perverts, predators, and pedophiles. Should they be representing our government? Alone in classrooms with our children? And as for parents, I agree this problem would have less traction if parents just said, “No.” But parents in Maryland had their child taken away because they refused to let their son transition to a “girl.” Parents in states like Vermont and Colorado saw their foster care licenses revoked because they admitted they would not help a child who may be assigned to their home get puberty blockers or have sex change surgery. Parents in California got themselves elected to the school board, passed guidelines to protect their children from the transgender movement, and now the state of California is suing them. Even with President Trump’s temporary Executive Orders attempting to ban men from women’s sports and bathrooms, and halt grotesque medical procedures for children... you can see, the radical transgender movement has parents backed into a corner. I’m sorry I’ve gone on so long detailing the transgender threat. But when I’m speaking around the country, I meet so many seniors who say, “I wish someone had told me about this sooner.” But the good news is that right now, you still have a chance to help stop the radical transgender movement before they push us down their slippery slide. And today I’m writing you on behalf of a group that is doing more work to block the transgender movement than anyone I know. It’s the legal non-profit the CENTER FOR AMERICAN LIBERTY. YES, I’LL STAND WITH RILEY [ And your gift is going straight to help them. With the help of patriots like you, the CENTER FOR AMERICAN LIBERTY fights the transgender movement in the courts because that’s the only way to stop them. And the CENTER FOR AMERICAN LIBERTY is attacking this evil from all sides with their comprehensive three-pronged approach. #1. THEY’RE FIGHTING RADICAL SCHOOLS. I know it may sound crazy to you but in today’s taxpayer-funded schools, teachers, and counselors encourage young children to socially “transition” at school and then facilitate the “transition” by giving children new names and even giving them new clothes so they can dress as the opposite sex. And they keep it all a secret from parents! You probably remember a time when kids needed a note from home just to get an aspirin at school! The CENTER FOR AMERICAN LIBERTY is taking these radicals to court in multiple cases. And they already have one major win! When you give, you’re making sure PARENTS have the final word in guiding their children -- not school radicals! #2. THEY’RE FIGHTING RADICAL DOCTORS. My fellow conservative, I hope you love and trust your doctors. There are lots of good ones out there. But there are also doctors who mutilate children for profit in the name of transgender “care.” They use their “expertise” to convince even conservative parents that if they oppose “transition,” their child will commit suicide. Then these doctors pump children full of dangerous puberty blockers and perform gruesome surgeries to remove children’s healthy breasts and other parts. Again, I apologize for the graphic description, but this is the pure evil we’re facing. Maybe you’ve seen a girl named Chloe Cole on Fox News. In a landmark case, the CENTER FOR AMERICAN LIBERTY is helping her sue the radical doctors and hospital that gave her a double mastectomy at age 15. President Trump signed an Executive Order aimed at protecting children from these grotesque doctors but a Biden-appointed federal judge has already blocked its enforcement. The best way to protect children is to contribute to help Chloe and the CENTER FOR AMERICAN LIBERTY win their case to make sure this never happens to another child! #3. THEY’RE FIGHTING FOR YOUR RIGHT TO SPEAK OUT AGAINST THIS HEINOUS EVIL. You’ll be happy to know that fighting for Freedom of Speech is one of the CENTER FOR AMERICAN LIBERTY’S specialties. They’ve notched plenty of victories in this space including fighting for an 82-year-old grandmother who got banned for life from the YMCA. This grandma raised the alarm that a grown man dressed in a women’s bathing suit was in the women’s locker room “helping” two little girls get ready to use the bathroom. And she was the one punished! But thanks to supporters just like you, the CENTER FOR AMERICAN LIBERTY fought back and won! And when you give, you’re helping them win all their critical cases confronting the evil of the transgender movement. YES, I’LL STAND WITH RILEY [ I know you’d probably love to fund an entire court case on your own after all I’ve told you, but all I’m asking you to do is RENEW YOUR SUPPORT with a tax-deductible gift of $30, $50, $75, $100 or even $250 or more. Please donate whatever amount is right for you whether it’s smaller or larger. The CENTER FOR AMERICAN LIBERTY needs and appreciates every dollar that comes in. And because I believe so strongly in the work they’re doing – and because they are one of the few groups who’ve stood shoulder-to-shoulder with me in this fight... It will be my honor to send you my new book “Swimming Against the Current: Fighting for Common Sense in a World That’s Lost Its Mind” as my free gift when you donate $50 or more to the CENTER FOR AMERICAN LIBERTY. [Lavine and Brinton] [ YES, I’LL STAND WITH RILEY [ Before I go, please let me share one last thought with you. Every morning as a competitive swimmer, I would get up and think of this verse: For I consider that the sufferings of the present time are not worthy to be compared to the glory that is about to be revealed to us. (Romans 8:18) I applied it to my swimming: work hard now and wins come later. But now I see that God has a much bigger plan for my life just as He does for yours. This battle isn’t about a swimming victory. It’s about Kingdom victory. I will never stop fighting to protect God’s Truth and I think you feel the same way. Thank you for reading my letter all the way to the end. I’m praying for you, and I hope you’ll pray for me too. Sincerely, Riley Gaines P.S. I’m so grateful that President Trump signed temporary Executive Orders aimed at stopping the radical transgender movement. But the Left is launching attacks in the courts to undermine him and we must fight back. God made man and God made woman. The attempts to deny those basic truths, are attempts to deny the truth of God. Your help is so critical to the CENTER FOR AMERICAN LIBERTY’S work, when you donate $50 or more, as my personal “Thank You,” I’ll send you my new book, “Swimming Against the Current: Fighting for Common Sense in a World That’s Lost Its Mind” for free. Please hurry. It’s getting hard to hold back this evil without you. I don’t want you to look back a year from now and say, “I wish I had done something when I had the chance.” SUPPORT CENTER FOR AMERICAN LIBERTY [ The Center for American Liberty is a 501(c)(3) nonprofit charitable organization fighting against growing anti-free speech and anti-civil liberties trends. Your gift is tax-deductible. Center for American Liberty PO Box 200942 Pittsburgh, PA 15251-0942

| | As if the stakes weren't already high enough for this year's midterm elections: public reporting now confirms that **Supreme Court Justice Samuel Alito is openly considering retiring.** **[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/140962681/652090321/-2044921950?refcode=2026-10-08-scotus&recurring=0&amount=&amounts=10,30,50,100,200&refcode2=dd803d02-35c3-f111-bf5b-000d3a4fbe83&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNDEvMS84OTQxMiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJkZDgwM2QwMi0zNWMzLWYxMTEtYmY1Yi0wMDBkM2E0ZmJlODMiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=vRWfOj1C_FQdud8Qu75Z-9kh8Osz4PdIH3NjGMBi7og=)** Whichever party controls the Senate in 2027 could well play a **major** part in shaping the future of the Supreme Court. In just a few years, we've seen the damage that's possible with a Trump-controlled Supreme Court. Reproductive freedoms gutted. Environmental protections erased. More control handed to special interests, corporations, and wealthy campaign donors to control our elections. We cannot afford to let Trump get another Supreme Court seat and solidify his ironclad grasp over the highest court in the country and force his agenda on the American people. **You can bet that GOP dark money groups are spending hundreds of millions of dollars across seven toss-up Senate races to make sure that they control the Senate if another seat on the bench opens up.** But we have the message. Friend, _**Even Taylor Swift calls Marsha “Trump in a wig”.**_ _****_ That’s because _while working families struggle to get by_ , _**Marsha is more concerned about making Tennessee “Trump Country”**_ than addressing the crises everyday people are suffering through. **Here’s what Trump has to say about what people like _YOU_ are going through, and Marsha is signing off on all of it:**
* “ _I don’t think about Americans’ financial situation. I don’t think about anybody.”_
* Surging gas costs are _ a “very inexpensive price to pay” _for Iran war.
* He called the affordability crisis a _“hoax”_.
* _“I love the inflation,”_ after it reaches a _3-year high._

subject: Need your signature to make Election Day a National Holiday
disclaimer_text: Paid for by VPP
body:
| Friend — Election Day should be a national holiday. Period.

Millions of eligible voters have to fit voting around work, school, childcare, and everything else life throws at them.

And as states continue debating and changing the rules around polling places, mail voting, early voting, and voter access, one thing should be simple:

**__No one_ _should have to choose between earning a paycheck and making their voice heard at the ballot box.**

That’s why the Voter Protection Project is joining [the People’s Election Day](https://act.protectvoting.org/go/136819?t=6&akid=29745%2E878179%2EBfoERO) to recognize Election Day as a national civic holiday — and we need grassroots supporters joining us.

[Will you add your name and pledge to make voting a priority this Election Day? → ](https://act.protectvoting.org/signup/election-day-natl-holiday?refcode=VPP_20261008_EMPET_E6_T0_AC&t=7&akid=29745%2E878179%2EBfoERO) | [ADD MY NAME →](https://act.protectvoting.org/signup/election-day-natl-holiday?refcode=VPP_20261008_EMPET_E6_T0_AC&t=8&akid=29745%2E878179%2EBfoERO)
---
Friend, voting shouldn’t be another errand people have to squeeze into an already packed day.

Giving people dedicated time to vote will also give people the opportunity to serve as poll workers, help family members get to the polls, volunteer in their communities, or simply cast their own ballot without worrying about missing hours at work.

**That’s the kind of democracy we want to help build: one where participation is accessible and every eligible voter has the opportunity to cast a ballot.**
But protecting that right takes resources.

[Election Day is coming fast. Add your name today to support making Election Day a national holiday → ](https://act.protectvoting.org/signup/election-day-natl-holiday?refcode=VPP_20261008_EMPET_E6_T0_AC&t=9&akid=29745%2E878179%2EBfoERO)

No One at the Wheel: Every Self-Driving Car Depends on a Chain Most People Never See
Tesla’s robotaxis have passed 1 million unsupervised miles and Giga Texas can build 125,000 Cybercabs a year. But none of it runs without a few highly specialized suppliers. In a race with many carmakers, the chokepoint is where the leverage sits.
Threat level 3/5 — Guarded

|

A car with nobody in the driver’s seat used to be science fiction. In 2026 it’s a ride you can hail in Austin. Watching one is unsettling at first, then oddly ordinary. But behind every one of those cars sits a chain of suppliers so specialized that if any link breaks, the whole thing stops. Most people never think about who those suppliers are.
The evidence board
| | Where Driverless Stands Today
---|---
| EVIDENCE
---
**Exhibit A — the miles.** In September, Tesla said its robotaxi fleet had passed 1 million unsupervised miles. Its service runs in seven U.S. metros. Its purpose-built Cybercab, with no steering wheel or pedals, entered the Austin fleet on September 4.
| EVIDENCE
---
**Exhibit B — the factory.** Giga Texas has installed capacity for more than 125,000 Cybercabs a year. For scale, Waymo runs about 4,000 vehicles and more than 500,000 paid rides a week.
| EVIDENCE
---
**Exhibit C — the dependency.** Every self-driving car runs an AI computer that makes driving decisions on board, in real time. Tesla’s next chip, AI5, is in trial production at Samsung’s new plant in Taylor, Texas, under a $16.5 billion deal. Only a handful of factories on earth can make chips that advanced.
The chain
| | What a Driverless Car Can’t Run Without
---|---
| The brainAdvanced AI chipsMade at the most advanced factories in the world. There are very few of them.
---
| The memoryHigh-bandwidth memoryTesla says AI5 has about 9x the memory bandwidth of the current chip. Data has to move as fast as the car thinks.
---
| The eyesCameras and sensorsFeeding the brain a constant stream of images, in rain, glare and darkness.
---
| The trainingData-center computeEvery mile driven becomes training data for the next version.
---
Decoder
| | Why a Chokepoint Is an Opportunity
---|---
| | “More than 1 million unsupervised miles.”— Tesla, at its September Cybercab event
---|---
What it says
Self-driving is working at real scale.
What it means
**Our theory:** the more these cars drive, the more every company in the chain matters. Carmakers compete fiercely with each other. But when a critical component comes from only one or two suppliers, every carmaker has to buy from them. That’s the kind of position that tends to get repriced once the volume shows up.
| ClassificationTransition
---
Driverless cars are on public roads and factories are ready to build them by the hundred thousand. The carmaker gets the attention. The company sitting at the narrowest point of the supply chain may get the leverage, and few investors have noticed it yet.
| The riddle · answer at the end of the fileIf dozens of companies are racing to build self-driving cars, why might the safest bet be a company that doesn’t build cars at all?

|
---
Riddle answer
**Because it sells to all of them.** A carmaker has to beat its rivals. A supplier of a critical part wins whenever any of them sells a car. **Our theory:** in every big technology shift, the companies at the chokepoints of the supply chain often turn out to be the steadier way to own the trend.

clean_body: | | | Across the Commonwealth | | ~ WAIT UNTIL 8TH WITH SAM RASOUL + RCC-PTA - Oct. 14 Join the community movement pledging not to give our children a smartphone until after 8th grade. Del. Sam Rasoul, Emily Harrison (Distraction Free Schools), Jessica Blandy (Roanoke City Council of PTAs/PTSAs), and Wesley Williams (RCPS Executive Director of Operations), will speak with community members about the benefits of not giving cell phones to children before they finish 8th grade. The event is Wednesday, Oct. 14 at 5:30 pm at Grandin Court Elementary School. A CALL TO ENGAGE ACROSS DIFFERENCES - Oct. 13 & 20 Points of Diversity, in partnership with SERV, invites all to participate in A Call to Engage Across Differences, a two-part interactive workshop designed to bridge divides in our community. Participants will explore how core values shape personal beliefs and gain practical skills for active listening, asking thoughtful questions, and navigating complex political, cultural, and ideological differences with curiosity, empathy, and respect. The events will be held on October 13 and October 20 from 6-7 pm at the Unitarian Universalist Church. | | In the Community | | NOMINATE THE 2026 CITIZEN OF THE YEAR Citizen of the Year award nominations are now being accepted by Roanoke City Council! Stroll through downtown, support local businesses, enjoy seasonal treats, and take in the sights, sounds, and colors of autumn in our community. ~ | SECOND ANNUAL EGYPTIAN FOOD FESTIVAL - Oct. 10-11 This weekend, come taste the delicious foods and learn more about the Egyptian Culture! The Second Annual Egyptian Food Festival will be held at St. Mary's Coptic Orthodox Church (4122 Cresthill Dr, Cave Spring, VA 24018) from 11am - 8pm this Saturday and Sunday. | SPOOKY SWEETS & TREATS \- Oct. 10 Join the Virginia Museum of Transportation for Spooky Sweets & Treats this Saturday, October 10th from 10 am - 3 pm. body:
When I ran for Congress, I promised results, not more empty talk from Washington. I want to show you exactly what that's looked like so far. | | |
---
| |
# With your support, we are delivering results.
---
| Friend,

When I ran for Congress, I promised results, not more empty talk from Washington. I want to show you exactly what that's looked like so far. Fighting for our water. I secured $1 billion in western water infrastructure funding, including $540 million going directly to California dams, canals, and water projects. I got $5 million to combat invasive golden mussels threatening our water systems, and delivered local wins for the Pine Flat Dam Raise, Eastman Lake Enlargement, and groundwater recharge projects across Fresno, Tulare, and Kaweah. I introduced the Water Infrastructure Resiliency Act to protect our water systems for the long haul, and I'm still fighting Sacramento's bureaucrats every time they try to take our water away. Standing up for our military and national security. I delivered nearly $98 million for NAS Lemoore's Strike Fighter Center of Excellence and F-35 hangar, and for a new Child Development Center at NAWS China Lake. I secured $39.5 million more for hypersonic testing, rocket lab infrastructure, and readiness programs at Edwards Air Force Base and China Lake, protecting the installations that anchor our local economy and our national defense. Bringing NASA innovation home. My ANCHOR Act, which protects cybersecurity on America's academic research fleet, passed the House 412-11. My ACERO Act, using NASA drone technology to help fight wildfires, advanced out of committee unanimously, 34-0. Cutting the red tape that's driving up your costs. I took on Gavin Newsom's "hidden climate tax" on cargo ships, forced accountability that led the Trump administration to finally pull the plug on California's high-speed rail boondoggle, and I'm pushing back on the State Water Board every time it tries to move the goalposts on Central Valley families. This is what showing up and doing the work looks like. I'm not finished. Not by a long shot. Thank you for standing with me, Sincerely

Congressman Vince Fong

| | | As a pediatrician, I’ve taken care of children on some of the worst days of their lives.

I’ve treated kids with broken bones, severe asthma, life-threatening infections—and, yes, gunshot wounds.

I’ve seen the trauma that gun violence causes, not just to the children who survive, but to their families, their classmates, and their communities.

_**It’s heartbreaking. And what’s worse is that it’s preventable.**_

That’s why it infuriates me to see people like Darline keep doing the gun lobby’s bidding.

**\- I’ve literally been at the bedside of children with bullet holes in them, missing parts of their skull and having to learn to walk and speak again.**

**\- Meanwhile, Darline says that to her "gun control is how steady you hold your weapon." It's no surprise she champions legislation that keeps us less safe.**

We can have safer schools, safer neighborhoods, and laws that put our children’s lives ahead of special interests. But to do that, we need new leadership in the U.S. Senate. Leadership that listens and acts in the best interest of the people that elected them, not the gun lobby.

Riley GainesWhat happened to me in the pool was only the beginning of my fight. ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌

https://click.parlermailer.com/?qs=ABl7ImQiOjUwMjMsInQiOjc2NywicyI6MTJ9AAwAAAAAA2hyoNfSjUxVJh4zzZUzc_Kagyth5ENn9fSAF7kCXy7DVyOfpAEEQXI25Jp_1RgVe4c22FRZpbLuIr5AMY4vzsnbPMzrHVdz_S_dSZ-2

Dear Fellow Conservative,

Even though we don’t know each other yet, I’m writing to ask you to stand beside me at the top of a very slippery slope.

Actually, in my case, it’s a slippery slide.

Because my name is Riley Gaines and I’m the University of Kentucky swimmer who had to compete against a fully intact 6’4” male swimmer dressed in a women’s bathing suit.

And after he stole the victory I had worked for my entire life, I had to go back to the women’s locker room and undress out of my wet bathing suit while he did the same next to me.

Maybe you want to stop reading right now.

I know the images I’m bringing up are horrible.

But please don’t stop.

Because God-fearing, faith-filled people like you and me have a job to do today.

We can’t retreat into our homes and hope President Trump will fix everything and the Left’s evil culture will just pass us by.

That’s why I’m asking you to give in the next 48 hours.

My fellow conservative, you know this slippery slide.

It’s the same one you got pushed down when the Left told you abortion was going to be “safe, legal, and rare.” Now abortion is a “right” and “women’s healthcare.” And if you don’t support it up until the moment of birth, you must “hate women.”

It’s the same slippery slide you got pushed down when the Left told you limiting gay couples to civil unions was “mean.” You were told, “They just want to use the word “marriage” like everyone else. It’s just a word.” Now if you don’t fully embrace the homosexual lifestyle by displaying rainbows and celebrating gay pride, you’re a “hate-filled bigot.”

Enough with their lies. We have Truth on our side. And we need to start acting like it.

God created man. And God created woman.

It isn’t any more complicated than that.

Letting men believe they are women... letting girls believe they are boys... is a bold-faced rejection of God’s truth.

President Trump is fighting these lies with temporary Executive Orders. But radical courts are already undermining him. We must stop this deranged movement from gaining one more inch.

We’ve got to counter them in the courts or rogue judges will rule that kids can be taken away from parents who oppose this evil... that schools can hide “transition” from parents... and that doctors can mutilate children with no consequences.

Your chance is right now – and right by my side.

Please stand with me against the radical transgender movement by making a gift in the next 48 hours.

https://click.parlermailer.com/?qs=ABl7ImQiOjUwMjMsInQiOjc2NywicyI6MTJ9AAwAAAAAA2hyoNfT7eLywh_OICMdZmgyfOYKcyguIJFAK7TsK3VlK9oNVws4ktpN54__PdocUBxbyZzXoQSeCoiHwTNEql7IWLAtg2sLPmxTRoeN
Yes, I’ll Stand With Riley

Please don’t tell me, “Riley, this isn’t a widespread problem.”

Look at this photo.

https://click.parlermailer.com/?qs=ABl7ImQiOjUwMjMsInQiOjc2NywicyI6MTJ9AAwAAAAAA2hyoNfUoupD2Ng65qd-IOfLi2Zv9s5h_HcPl4knI1VUmlwqLAh_AGw-f6sUvfr7z_vBrCmg1LidJta2jmRTWg4nNyzetUbJG_I76R7E

This is pediatrician, 4-star admiral, and former Assistant Secretary for Health -- Rachel Levine (born Richard Levine). This man in a women’s Navy uniform has been a “leader” in your government.

And the person standing next to Levine? That’s Sam Brinton. He’s a man in a dress who was a Biden-Harris nuclear official until he got caught stealing luggage at Ronald Reagan Airport filled with ladies clothes.

Then consider that 11 states and counting, plus the District of Columbia, are transgender “sanctuary” states. That means in some of them, minor children can flee there and get transgender services -- even sex change operations -- without their parents’ permission.

And did you know Medicare now covers sex change operations?

It just goes on and on... This evil is widespread.

Or maybe you’re thinking like so many, “Riley, adults are free to do whatever they want. And children should be kept away from this evil by their parents.”

As for the transgender adults, your generation used to call these people perverts, predators, and pedophiles.

Should they be representing our government? Alone in classrooms with our children?

And as for parents, I agree this problem would have less traction if parents just said, “No.”

But parents in Maryland had their child taken away because they refused to let their son transition to a “girl.”

Parents in states like Vermont and Colorado saw their foster care licenses revoked because they admitted they would not help a child who may be assigned to their home get puberty blockers or have sex change surgery.

Parents in California got themselves elected to the school board, passed guidelines to protect their children from the transgender movement, and now the state of California is suing them.

Even with President Trump’s temporary Executive Orders attempting to ban men from women’s sports and bathrooms, and halt grotesque medical procedures for children... you can see, the radical transgender movement has parents backed into a corner.

I’m sorry I’ve gone on so long detailing the transgender threat. But when I’m speaking around the country, I meet so many seniors who say, “I wish someone had told me about this sooner.”

But the good news is that right now, you still have a chance to help stop the radical transgender movement before they push us down their slippery slide.

And today I’m writing you on behalf of a group that is doing more work to block the transgender movement than anyone I know.

It’s the legal non-profit the Center for American Liberty.

https://click.parlermailer.com/?qs=ABl7ImQiOjUwMjMsInQiOjc2NywicyI6MTJ9AAwAAAAAA2hyoNfV38PExo-lL56hBciwE6qZcGJKpKmmYR7djIU6Zu6fqdwZtTkJJVic1jUO8zR8MiPJNF0j9Yr_cr5ncL1MJ-PaFLyYOgupObCt
Yes, I’ll Stand With Riley

And your gift is going straight to help them.

With the help of patriots like you, the Center for American Liberty fights the transgender movement in the courts because that’s the only way to stop them.

And the Center for American Liberty is attacking this evil from all sides with their comprehensive three-pronged approach.

#1. They’re fighting radical schools.

I know it may sound crazy to you but in today’s taxpayer-funded schools, teachers, and counselors encourage young children to socially “transition” at school and then facilitate the “transition” by giving children new names and even giving them new clothes so they can dress as the opposite sex.

And they keep it all a secret from parents!

You probably remember a time when kids needed a note from home just to get an aspirin at school!

The Center for American Liberty is taking these radicals to court in multiple cases. And they already have one major win!

When you give, you’re making sure PARENTS have the final word in guiding their children -- not school radicals!

#2. They’re fighting radical doctors.

My fellow conservative, I hope you love and trust your doctors. There are lots of good ones out there.

But there are also doctors who mutilate children for profit in the name of transgender “care.” They use their “expertise” to convince even conservative parents that if they oppose “transition,” their child will commit suicide.

Then these doctors pump children full of dangerous puberty blockers and perform gruesome surgeries to remove children’s healthy breasts and other parts.

Again, I apologize for the graphic description, but this is the pure evil we’re facing.

Maybe you’ve seen a girl named Chloe Cole on Fox News. In a landmark case, the Center for American Liberty is helping her sue the radical doctors and hospital that gave her a double mastectomy at age 15.

President Trump signed an Executive Order aimed at protecting children from these grotesque doctors but a Biden-appointed federal judge has already blocked its enforcement.

The best way to protect children is to contribute to help Chloe and the Center for American Liberty win their case to make sure this never happens to another child!

#3. They’re fighting for your right to speak out against this heinous evil.

You’ll be happy to know that fighting for Freedom of Speech is one of the Center for American Liberty’s specialties.

They’ve notched plenty of victories in this space including fighting for an 82-year-old grandmother who got banned for life from the YMCA.

This grandma raised the alarm that a grown man dressed in a women’s bathing suit was in the women’s locker room “helping” two little girls get ready to use the bathroom.

And she was the one punished!

But thanks to supporters just like you, the Center for American Liberty fought back and won! And when you give, you’re helping them win all their critical cases confronting the evil of the transgender movement.

https://click.parlermailer.com/?qs=ABl7ImQiOjUwMjMsInQiOjc2NywicyI6MTJ9AAwAAAAAA2hyoNfW84YDbwOf_kksiDCqZj0r-ZcYVuJrjQWkOjqcXD-27g5_NvRR6QwNHufqY62NHIP0BAcCsdyLJi8qMGoQNWxdnZncbOS7uUpH
Yes, I’ll Stand With Riley

I know you’d probably love to fund an entire court case on your own after all I’ve told you, but all I’m asking you to do is renew your support with a tax-deductible gift of $30, $50, $75, $100 or even $250 or more.

Please donate whatever amount is right for you whether it’s smaller or larger. The Center for American Liberty needs and appreciates every dollar that comes in.

And because I believe so strongly in the work they’re doing – and because they are one of the few groups who’ve stood shoulder-to-shoulder with me in this fight...

It will be my honor to send you my new book “Swimming Against the Current: Fighting for Common Sense in a World That’s Lost Its Mind” as my free gift when you donate $50 or more to the Center for American Liberty.

If you’re ready to flip Alaska and understand how important this last deadline is, I am asking you to make today the day you split a donation between my campaign for U.S. Senate and Roy Cooper._](https://act.roycooper.com/go/19742?refcode=email_bu_pros_jtk1625&amount=5&t=10&akid=4293%2E124072%2E2HLF6u)**

The New York Times had us down 2 points in June, so this is a huge move in our direction. But this surge didn’t come out of nowhere...
Thanks to this grassroots team, we have been able to ramp up our campaign across Alaska — and it’s paying off. Advertising, organizing, traveling statewide: It’s all working to bring Alaskans together in our movement.

The strength of this campaign has always come from regular people stepping up when it counted. And it means a lot to me that so many of you have faith in our ability to win. Together, we’re building a movement.
Thanks for being a part of it, Peter.

National Republicans will target North Carolina as a key battleground and invest heavily in defeating us.

# [Most officials want another hike. Markets bet December](https://substack.com/redirect/778b860f-53a4-4b50-a2ec-dc47a1beecd2?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
September **[minutes show most officials](https://substack.com/redirect/adcc4096-b636-4d6e-b7a1-dd2cf74eb1f9?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** expect **[another rate increase before year-end,](https://substack.com/redirect/a565991d-f864-4067-9c1e-38c437a21e23?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** with no date named, as Governor Waller said Thursday that extra hikes need not come at back-to-back meetings.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/778b860f-53a4-4b50-a2ec-dc47a1beecd2?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
* **Year-end hike view** : The minutes said most participants judged that another increase in the target range "would likely be appropriate by year end," while stressing that **[each meeting stays open to the data.](https://substack.com/redirect/c2ad6490-541e-45f1-b06d-22f13369ce65?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)**
* **Unanimous quarter point** : Officials[ ](https://substack.com/redirect/016811da-b7f5-4abe-9436-8660ab5d3606?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)**[voted as one](https://substack.com/redirect/016811da-b7f5-4abe-9436-8660ab5d3606?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** to lift the benchmark a quarter point, to a 3.75%-4% range, the first increase in three years.
* **October looks unlikely** : Futures price a hold at the Oct. 28-29 meeting and a rise in December. Vice Chair Jefferson said officials "will need to come to our own judgement, which may take more time."
* **Waller timing window** : In Istanbul, Waller said that if the data come in as expected he **[anticipates more hikes,](https://substack.com/redirect/016811da-b7f5-4abe-9436-8660ab5d3606?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** and that they "do not need to come at consecutive meetings" but should arrive[ ](https://substack.com/redirect/e0684fb9-ebfb-44c0-abc1-6f777efff744?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)**["in an acceptable period of time."](https://substack.com/redirect/e0684fb9-ebfb-44c0-abc1-6f777efff744?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)**

[Upgrade to paid](https://substack..fzvn5IDEfja-z_DofFhmv4tf_SKGFCP0ooB-NqXrIVk?&utm_medium=email&utm_source=subscribe-widget&utm_content=219430050)
* * *
# [A 55% surge, and it still is not TSMC's best month](https://substack.com/redirect/778b860f-53a4-4b50-a2ec-dc47a1beecd2?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
Taiwan Semiconductor posted September sales of NT$511.86 billion, **[up 54.6% from a year earlier,](https://substack.com/redirect/115e627d-9f24-4b4d-8780-4c6aa9af9694?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)**[ ](https://substack.com/redirect/115e627d-9f24-4b4d-8780-4c6aa9af9694?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)and a third quarter of about NT$1.49 trillion that cleared the analyst average.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/778b860f-53a4-4b50-a2ec-dc47a1beecd2?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
* **Not a monthly record** : September net revenue was NT$511.86 billion, **[or $16.03 billion, up 54.6% from a year earlier](https://substack.com/redirect/0e4a3214-48b6-47b7-889a-d822bec3d064?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** and down 0.6% from August. CNBC corrected an earlier claim that the month set a record.

Samsung on Thursday forecast third-quarter operating profit of 107.40 trillion won, or $80.2 billion, **[a 782% jump from a year earlier that still left the shares down 0.7%.](https://substack.com/redirect/1dd9e704-93e7-4948-8b14-72cb8bf0fb5a?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)**

---|---|---
* **First past 100 trillion** : Operating profit of 107.40 trillion won is the first time the company has cleared 100 trillion won in a quarter. Revenue is forecast near 195 trillion won, up almost 127%.
* **Still short of hopes** : Josh Gilbert of eToro said Samsung has **["delivered a record profit and still fallen short of expectations,"](https://substack.com/redirect/968e9358-b44f-4a99-8b43-8dd4e0e327fe?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)**[ ](https://substack.com/redirect/968e9358-b44f-4a99-8b43-8dd4e0e327fe?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)a sign of how demanding the AI memory trade has become.
* **Multiyear chip orders** : Gilbert said buyers are signing multiyear supply deals, and that AI agents can use far more memory than a chatbot answering one question. Supply remains tight.
* **Prior quarter context** : Second-quarter operating profit was a record 89.5 trillion won. Samsung partnered with Mistral AI in September, and a full division breakdown is due later this month.

# [Gas heat bills fall 9%. Oil heat jumps 21%](https://substack.com/redirect/778b860f-53a4-4b50-a2ec-dc47a1beecd2?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
The EIA's Tuesday winter outlook says **[households on natural gas and propane, about half the country, should spend less,](https://substack.com/redirect/afae20cf-9ae1-495d-8083-19dcecac7644?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)**[ ](https://substack.com/redirect/afae20cf-9ae1-495d-8083-19dcecac7644?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)while heating-oil and electric homes face higher bills.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/778b860f-53a4-4b50-a2ec-dc47a1beecd2?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
* **Gas spending lower** : Homes heated mainly by natural gas are forecast to spend 9% less than last winter. The West is the exception, up 7%, while other regions fall 10% to 15%.
* **Propane mostly down** : Propane households are seen spending 3% less, in a range from a 10% drop to an 8% rise. The South is flat, the Midwest down 4%, and the Northeast down 15%.
* **Oil and power up** : Heating oil is projected up 21%, with uncertainty of 15% to 35%. Electric homes are up 4%: West 9%, South and Midwest 3%, Northeast down 3%.
* **Weather can swing** : National temperatures are forecast similar to last year, warmer in the Northeast and colder in the West. NOAA has flagged a strong El Niño that could move the forecast.

| [](https://substack.com/redirect/778b860f-53a4-4b50-a2ec-dc47a1beecd2?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
* **Already in four markets** : The partnership already reaches more than 3 million customers, including Dallas-Fort Worth, Atlanta, Houston, and Orlando. Wing announced the new metros on Monday.
* **Rain and winter routes** : Seattle and Denver add Pacific Northwest rain and Colorado winters to the map. Wing's Rivera said the pace shows how quickly households are adopting drone delivery.

* **Rivals also flying** : Lowe's started a Sept. 24 North Carolina Wing pilot, the first home-improvement retailer aboard. Amazon in August aimed Prime Air at nearly 500 US cities and towns by year-end.

# [Ram recalls 265,512 vans that can lose steering assist](https://substack.com/redirect/778b860f-53a4-4b50-a2ec-dc47a1beecd2?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
Chrysler is **[recalling 265,512 Ram ProMaster cargo vans](https://substack.com/redirect/939203a6-f356-492c-b1a6-24c5eb66ca1a?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** from the 2022-2026 model years after water can reach the electric power-steering harness and drop assist without warning.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/778b860f-53a4-4b50-a2ec-dc47a1beecd2?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
* **Four model lines** : The notice covers 44,391 Ram 1500s, 147,204 Ram 2500s, and 72,043 Ram 3500s from 2022-2026, plus 1,874 Ram 3500 EV vans from 2024-2026.
* **No warning given** : Water can enter the electric power-steering wiring harness and damage it. Drivers may get no alert before assist fails, and NHTSA said that raises crash risk.
* **One crash known** : Stellantis knows of one non-injury accident, Frank Matyok told The Detroit News. Dealers will inspect and, if needed, replace the harness and steering gear free.
* **Letters on Nov. 17** : Interim owner notices are expected to mail Nov. 17. A second letter goes out once the final remedy is available.

Eighteen years ago, I completed my final treatment for breast cancer.

Surviving breast cancer made me realize I couldn’t put off the things I was passionate about, and it made me reevaluate the impact that I could make on the world with whatever time I was privileged enough to have.

At that time, the city of Glendale hadn't had a woman on its council in over a decade, and had elected less than ten women in its almost hundred-year history. Glendale had a conservative council, unwilling to stop the Glendale gun show from operating on city property, and uninterested in making environmental sustainability a priority.

**So I decided to do something about it. I ran for city council.**

What started as just me and a handful of women -- stuffing envelopes and walking precincts -- turned into one of the largest grassroots campaigns we'd seen in years. The morning after election day, I was the top vote-getter despite running against three incumbents.

Here’s the truth: I've never considered myself a politician.

My work has always been about bringing people together to address the very real issues we all face, and that hasn't changed since I joined Congress.

I'll continue to advocate _for us._ We need solutions to issues like affordable housing and the cost of living. Our government needs to treat health care like a human right accessible to all. And we need to tackle the climate crisis with the urgency it deserves.

A Congressional majority would help make all of this within reach.

clean_body: | = | | = | **= Eighteen years ago, I completed my final treatment for breast cancer. Surviving breast cancer made me realize I couldn’t put off the things I was passionate about, and it made me reevaluate the impact that I could make on the world with whatever time I was privileged enough to have. At that time, the city of Glendale hadn't had a woman on its council in over a decade, and had elected less than ten women in its almost hundred-year history. Glendale had a conservative council, unwilling to stop the Glendale gun show from operating on city property, and uninterested in making environmental sustainability a priority. So I decided to do something about it. I ran for city council. What started as just me and a handful of women -- stuffing envelopes and walking precincts -- turned into one of the largest grassroots campaigns we'd seen in years. The morning after election day, I was the top vote-getter despite running against three incumbents. Here’s the truth: I've never considered myself a politician. My work has always been about bringing people together to address the very real issues we all face, and that hasn't changed since I joined Congress. I'll continue to advocate for us. We need solutions to issues like affordable housing and the cost of living. Our government needs to treat health care like a human right accessible to all. And we need to tackle the climate crisis with the urgency it deserves. A Congressional majority would help make all of this within reach. # [ ](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/140970215/652111530/-1343999874?refcode=em-header&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNjIvMS8xMTc1MjUiLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiZDJmMjc0NDctNDBjMy1mMTExLWJmNWItMDAwZDNhNGZiZTgzIiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=usp6pgWOsFWGvQX65Re--wrrE6aD9OS5-rVagVpJW1c=)
Peter,

We're less than a month out from Election Day, and _a lot_ has been happening in our race to flip CA-22. Outside money is flooding in. The attacks keep coming. And you've been with me every step of the way.

So I want to take a step back from all that — and remind you why I got in this race to begin with. **[If you already know you're with us, you can chip in $3 right now and I'll see you on the other side. If you've got a minute, I'd love to tell you my story.](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/140970216/652111531/1733485175?refcode=em-10.8.26-all-1-a&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNjIvMS8xMTc1MjUiLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiZDJmMjc0NDctNDBjMy1mMTExLWJmNWItMDAwZDNhNGZiZTgzIiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=usp6pgWOsFWGvQX65Re--wrrE6aD9OS5-rVagVpJW1c=)**
[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/140970217/652111532/1733485175?refcode=em-10.8.26-all-1-a&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNjIvMS8xMTc1MjUiLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiZDJmMjc0NDctNDBjMy1mMTExLWJmNWItMDAwZDNhNGZiZTgzIiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=usp6pgWOsFWGvQX65Re--wrrE6aD9OS5-rVagVpJW1c=)
_Back in the day at Palla Elementary School in Bakersfield (Go Bulldogs!)_
I grew up in Bakersfield, the son of Mexican immigrants. My dad opened an auto shop here in 2006. My mom was a homemaker. We didn't have much — I shared a bunk bed in the living room with my brothers. On weekends, I worked at the swap meet and helped out at the shop.

Nobody in my family had ever gone to college. I was the first.

I watched my parents work themselves to the bone in a Valley that wasn’t built for families like ours. I watched my older brother navigate life as a DACA recipient, always one policy change away from losing everything. I proudly saw my younger brother put on a uniform to serve our country as a Marine.

The Central Valley made me who I am. And for a long time, I thought the best way I could give back was to teach. So I became a professor at College of the Sequoias and a school board trustee -- making sure kids in this Valley had more doors open to them than I did.

But something kept nagging at me.

CA-22 has been represented by David Valadao for years. He looked Central Valley families in the eye and promised us he would never cut Medicaid — which is a lifeline for hundreds of thousands of our neighbors. Then he voted for Trump's budget and did exactly that.
[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/140970218/652111533/1733485175?refcode=em-10.8.26-all-1-a&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNjIvMS8xMTc1MjUiLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiZDJmMjc0NDctNDBjMy1mMTExLWJmNWItMDAwZDNhNGZiZTgzIiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=usp6pgWOsFWGvQX65Re--wrrE6aD9OS5-rVagVpJW1c=)
I was at those rallies with the nurses, farmworkers, and ordinary working families who couldn't believe their representative had sold them out. And I kept thinking: someone has to run against him. Someone who actually knows what it means to need Medicaid. Someone who grew up and built a life here.

So I got in. Not because I wanted to be something, but because I wanted to _do something_ \-- for the families who can't afford to see a doctor, for the parents who can't afford rent, for the kids growing up in a Valley with dirty air, broken promises and no one in Washington fighting for them.

And with your support, we’re going to win.

**[Corporate PACs and special interests are propping up Valadao's campaign, and they're not going anywhere between now and November. We need to keep our message in front of voters. Can you chip in $3 to help us finish what we started?](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/140970219/652111534/1733485175?refcode=em-10.8.26-all-1-a&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNjIvMS8xMTc1MjUiLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiZDJmMjc0NDctNDBjMy1mMTExLWJmNWItMDAwZDNhNGZiZTgzIiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=usp6pgWOsFWGvQX65Re--wrrE6aD9OS5-rVagVpJW1c=)**

clean_body: | = Peter, We're less than a month out from Election Day, and a lot has been happening in our race to flip CA-22. Outside money is flooding in. The attacks keep coming. And you've been with me every step of the way. So I want to take a step back from all that — and remind you why I got in this race to begin with. = = Back in the day at Palla Elementary School in Bakersfield (Go Bulldogs!) I grew up in Bakersfield, the son of Mexican immigrants. My dad opened an auto shop here in 2006. My mom was a homemaker. We didn't have much — I shared a bunk bed in the living room with my brothers. On weekends, I worked at the swap meet and helped out at the shop. Nobody in my family had ever gone to college. I was the first. I watched my parents work themselves to the bone in a Valley that wasn’t built for families like ours. I watched my older brother navigate life as a DACA recipient, always one policy change away from losing everything. I proudly saw my younger brother put on a uniform to serve our country as a Marine. The Central Valley made me who I am. And for a long time, I thought the best way I could give back was to teach. So I became a professor at College of the Sequoias and a school board trustee -- making sure kids in this Valley had more doors open to them than I did. But something kept nagging at me. CA-22 has been represented by David Valadao for years. He looked Central Valley families in the eye and promised us he would never cut Medicaid — which is a lifeline for hundreds of thousands of our neighbors. Then he voted for Trump's budget and did exactly that. = I was at those rallies with the nurses, farmworkers, and ordinary working families who couldn't believe their representative had sold them out. And I kept thinking: someone has to run against him. Someone who actually knows what it means to need Medicaid. Someone who grew up and built a life here. So I got in. Not because I wanted to be something, but because I wanted to do something \-- for the families who can't afford to see a doctor, for the parents who can't afford rent, for the kids growing up in a Valley with dirty air, broken promises and no one in Washington fighting for them. And with your support, we’re going to win. = If you've saved your payment information with ActBlue Express, your donation will go through immediately: | | | = | = | | = | = | | = | = Thanks, Randy | With deep ties to our community and a lifelong commitment to justice and equity, Randy is running for Congress in California’s 22nd District to bring bold, compassionate leadership to Washington. # THE AARON DAY SHOW
Defending Free Will in the Age of Technocracy
S3E26 • Oct 8
## Third Party Is the Lever: 7 Races, 1 Senate
[ ](https://us.list-manage.com/ZPJV39xkQo5?e=938a87a89b&c2id=c1b996ddd6cdaaf4cddb384f099ac837)
Did you fall for it again?
Every two years they hand you the same menu. Red or blue. Lesser of two evils. Hold your nose, pull the lever, and wait for the promises to come true.
They don't.
Energy prices cut in half. Tariffs replacing the income tax. Drain the swamp. Release the Epstein files, he said in 2024; in July 2025 his Justice Department said no further disclosure was warranted. And no matter which party holds the gavel, the technocracy keeps advancing. The two-party trap only works if you believe you have nowhere else to go. That's how they keep you demoralized, and that's how they keep you voting for the people who betray you.
Here's what they don't want you to see. A third party is not a wasted vote. It's a lever.
Tonight at 6:00 PM ET, I'm going live with the full StarkFreedom PAC plan. StarkFreedom backs third-party candidates in seven close U.S. Senate races: New Hampshire, Texas, Kansas, Michigan, Ohio, Iowa, and South Carolina. In races this close, the third-party vote can be bigger than the margin. In 2024 that happened in 58 races. And the margin decides who controls the Senate.
The message is simple: break your promises and you lose the seat. That goes for the GOP this cycle, and it goes for the Democrats too. No party gets our votes for free.
Expose. Obstruct. Exit. Build.
I'll walk through all seven races, the receipts, and the math that turns your vote from a sigh into leverage. Then I'll show you exactly how to plug in: back the PAC at starkfreedom.org and join the StarkFreedom Street Team on Facebook.
Stop picking the lesser evil. Start holding both parties accountable.
Live tonight, 6:00 PM ET.

clean_body: THE AARON DAY SHOW Defending Free Will in the Age of Technocracy S3E26 • Oct 8 Third Party Is the Lever: 7 Races, 1 Senate Did you fall for it again? Every two years they hand you the same menu. Red or blue. Lesser of two evils. Hold your nose, pull the lever, and wait for the promises to come true. They don't. Energy prices cut in half. Tariffs replacing the income tax. Drain the swamp. Release the Epstein files, he said in 2024; in July 2025 his Justice Department said no further disclosure was warranted. And no matter which party holds the gavel, the technocracy keeps advancing. The two-party trap only works if you believe you have nowhere else to go. That's how they keep you demoralized, and that's how they keep you voting for the people who betray you. Here's what they don't want you to see. A third party is not a wasted vote. It's a lever. Tonight at 6:00 PM ET, I'm going live with the full StarkFreedom PAC plan. StarkFreedom backs third-party candidates in seven close U.S. Senate races: New Hampshire, Texas, Kansas, Michigan, Ohio, Iowa, and South Carolina. In races this close, the third-party vote can be bigger than the margin. In 2024 that happened in 58 races. And the margin decides who controls the Senate. The message is simple: break your promises and you lose the seat. That goes for the GOP this cycle, and it goes for the Democrats too. No party gets our votes for free. Expose. Obstruct. Exit. Build. I'll walk through all seven races, the receipts, and the math that turns your vote from a sigh into leverage. Then I'll show you exactly how to plug in: back the PAC at starkfreedom.org and join the StarkFreedom Street Team on Facebook. Stop picking the lesser evil. Start holding both parties accountable. subject: Greg Abbott can’t defend his own record

# [](https://ginafortexas.com/?refcode=em_ms_gh_header)[](https://ginafortexas.com/?refcode=em_ms_gh_header)

After two polls showing me leading this race, Abbott dropped a whopping $12 million dollars on misleading ads designed to tear me down. _Why_? Because after over a decade in office, Greg Abbott has absolutely nothing to defend from his own record. So instead, he’s lying about mine.

name: Bethany Mann for Congress
subject: I’m glad you’re here
body:
Thank you for being with us!

| | | | | [|
---](https://us.list-manage.com/SMnli6jSS39?e=519ef02502&c2id=654d9c3339d5694b9267d382db7ced0e)
| | | | | |
Hi —I’m really glad you’re here.
If you joined this list, I don’t think you’re looking for another polished political newsletter telling you everything is fine, asking for a donation, and calling it a day. Because everything is not fine, and pretending otherwise isn’t going to fix it.
I got into this race because I was tired of watching a system that is supposed to serve ordinary people bend toward whoever has the most money, the most influence, or the loudest voice in the room. Too many politicians have learned to avoid the hard fights, duck accountability, and hope people are too exhausted or distracted to notice.
I notice. I know you do, too.
This campaign is about building something different here in Missouri’s 3rd District: a campaign willing to tell the truth, stand with our neighbors when their communities are being ignored, and fight for working people instead of asking them to settle for less.
Most importantly, we’re building it together.
Over the next few weeks, I’ll tell you more about who I am, what we’re fighting for, what we’re up against, and what we’re hearing from people across this district. I’ll also let you know when there are opportunities to knock doors, make calls, show up in your community, spread the word, or help us raise the resources we need to compete.
For now, the most important thing you can do is stay connected. Read these emails, share our campaign with someone you trust, follow along with what we’re doing across the district, and when you’re ready, find a way to get involved.
We’re not going to change things by being cautious about what we believe or quiet about what our communities deserve. We’re going to do it by organizing, showing up, and refusing to accept that the people with the most money should always have the most power.
I’m glad you’re here. We have a lot of work ahead of us, and I’m excited to do it together.
Bethany MannCandidate for Congress, Missouri’s 3rd District

clean_body: Thank you for being with us! | | | | | | | | | | | Hi —I’m really glad you’re here. If you joined this list, I don’t think you’re looking for another polished political newsletter telling you everything is fine, asking for a donation, and calling it a day. Because everything is not fine, and pretending otherwise isn’t going to fix it. I got into this race because I was tired of watching a system that is supposed to serve ordinary people bend toward whoever has the most money, the most influence, or the loudest voice in the room. Too many politicians have learned to avoid the hard fights, duck accountability, and hope people are too exhausted or distracted to notice. I notice. I know you do, too. This campaign is about building something different here in Missouri’s 3rd District: a campaign willing to tell the truth, stand with our neighbors when their communities are being ignored, and fight for working people instead of asking them to settle for less. Most importantly, we’re building it together. Over the next few weeks, I’ll tell you more about who I am, what we’re fighting for, what we’re up against, and what we’re hearing from people across this district. I’ll also let you know when there are opportunities to knock doors, make calls, show up in your community, spread the word, or help us raise the resources we need to compete. For now, the most important thing you can do is stay connected. Read these emails, share our campaign with someone you trust, follow along with what we’re doing across the district, and when you’re ready, find a way to get involved. We’re not going to change things by being cautious about what we believe or quiet about what our communities deserve. We’re going to do it by organizing, showing up, and refusing to accept that the people with the most money should always have the most power. I’m glad you’re here. We have a lot of work ahead of us, and I’m excited to do it together. Bethany MannCandidate for Congress, Missouri’s 3rd District | | | | | | | | | | | | | | | | | | | | | | | | | | | | | | Bethany Mann for Congress PO Box 12 Wentzville, MO 63385 * USA or |

| | Dear Friend,

In the spring of 1775, a handful of farmers and tradesmen stood their ground against the greatest military power on earth.

They didn't know how the story would end.

But they knew that freedom was worth fighting for.

The "shot heard 'round the world" set in motion a chain of events that led to the greatest experiment in self-government the world has ever known.

That's why I'm excited to share something special with you.

Now let me tell you why this mission means so much to me. My name is Eduardo Verastegui. Several years ago, I learned firsthand about the horrific reality of child trafficking. What I heard broke my heart. Children were being bought and sold.
Families were being torn apart.
Lives were being destroyed. **I couldn't forget it.** **I couldn't stay silent.** I kept asking myself one question: **"What if it were my child?"** That question changed my life. What started as a film project became a mission and a calling. That calling eventually led me to help produce the film _Sound of Freedom_. **Not for fame.**
**Not for awards.**
**But because I believed people needed to see the truth.** For years, many people said the film would never succeed. Doors closed.
Studios walked away.
People told us to give up. **But when innocent children are suffering, silence is not an option.** And while the film helped awaken millions of people to this crisis, awareness alone is not enough. That is why we created the **Sound of Freedom Foundation**. Our mission is simple: **To stop the sale of God's children.**

As governor, she will work to put fresh food on tables and make life more affordable for families across New Mexico.
