Hey Peter, it’s Cait. I want to be real with you here. Things are about to get a little crazy, but please. Stick with me. Next week, our campaign has its very last FEC deadline of the election. On that same day, Mike Lawler and I will take the stage again for debate number two. And then not long after that, New York starts voting. So I want to be candid: During this next week, we’re going to have to push incredibly hard to hit our fundraising goals. I’m writing in part to apologize in advance for how much we’re going to be reaching out. But I’m also writing to remind you that there’s a reason we’re doing it. It’s not to annoy you or stress you out. It’s because emails like this, texts, digital ads—these are a huge chunk of our budget. Donations from folks like you are a fundamental way we fund this campaign. If I could win this race without sending a single email, I’d do it. But I can tell you with 100% certainty that if we don’t email... we won’t raise what we need. We won’t be able to reach the voters we have to turn out. We’d be setting ourselves up to hand this race to Mike Lawler. I can’t let that happen, and I think you agree with me there. You are a critical part of this team. And with that apology, with this explanation, I hope you understand how important you really are to all of this. Now, if you’re still here, and if you still have my back, I have to make a humble request of you: [**Can you please make your first online donation to my campaign to flip NY-17? With our final FEC deadline, and our debate, and early voting all on the horizon, there’s never been a more important moment to chip in.**](https://click.actionnetwork.org/ss/c/u001.iIBo0N5fSFzEFL40Tn-vtbMETCUYClkOrOh9-SNJfquqiBIysd_1t7dQL51NYrcynj_UHKTnEbFJuXRbcU0RusMeK8Uw0hMFlhZHdKfCOjyEK6B6lM6avXSJwAJ-3F9KYmqVY01ll3gBoSH4IvlJpvCBrdckmE2lM8Gi7IwqMJASYinQsoW5TUnNfhB0d2B8f4vckfUaTWLJqOHO4sHKEcyUNbPrwNxZAuTdA0BZVt3xn8dFmcXHtjV4PQzvyg-LnJkialwjkAu4WAfTzwPnWMBNDMovkiJluYkOzS7_I8s1EwAo9gz1irQHx-Ki3FcnF4vNOhPRaffHakXZm8U0hg/4up/mrRwg9qKQfCDWuxw9yZMpQ/h1/h001.IC31zNAsRI-MHWXhxYog3qxLVMVc8DgXJYa9qVS0Y6U) | If you've stored your payment information with ActBlue Express, your donation will process now.

But the wrong choice will be catastrophic for New York. | | | | Dear Patriot, Please join me and an army of New Yorkers who are sick and tired of being miserable under radical Kathy Hochul. The choice is yours... Safety, affordability, and freedom with a Republican governor. High taxes, high crime, and socialism with Hochul. It's simple. But the wrong choice will be catastrophic for New York. We can't survive any more of Hochul's criminals first, illegals first, socialists first, and New Yorkers LAST agenda. Everything you and I have gone through in the past few years (unaffordable prices, lawlessness, illegal alien invasion, pro-terrorism riots, rampant social services fraud) will get 10x worse if Hochul wins and greenlights Zohran Mamdani's Communist pipe dream. You know it's true because she's already doing it. She endorsed him and paved the way for Democratic Socialists of America (DSA) radicals to win primary elections in NYC. She gave Mamdani a $1.5 billion bailout to fund his socialist agenda. And in their first meeting after Mamdani won the election, they met for over an hour to talk about how to "protect" New York from the Trump administration. How about Hochul protect New Yorkers from getting stabbed on the subway? Or protect New Yorkers against the career criminals she keeps releasing from jail? Or protect New Yorkers from violent illegal aliens who she's helping to evade ICE deportation? Or protect New Yorkers from fraudsters who want to rob their hard-earned taxes blind? She won't. She won't protect New Yorkers like you because she's too busy protecting herself, her Comrades in NYC, and her precious political career. I'm running for Governor of New York because we've got one chance to take Hochul out of power and turn New York around, and we can't waste it. My name is Bruce Blakeman. You may know me as the Republican Nassau County Executive who fought against sanctuary policies, rejected mask mandates, stopped boys from playing in girls' sports, hired hundreds of new police officers to make Nassau the safest county in America, and accomplished all of that without raising taxes by a single penny. But today I want you to know me as the conservative who can flip New York... Nassau County has 110,000 more registered Democrats than Republicans, yet I won the race for County Executive twice, winning my re-election by a decisive 56% without compromising my values. Many pundits see Nassau County as a demographic mirror of the state, which means I already have a proven strategy to win. Recent polls show that only 37% of New Yorkers want Kathy Hochul to run for re-election, and a whopping 51% want somebody else. So not only is radical Kathy Hochul in the worst political position she's ever been in... but she's going up against a Republican who knows how to win in New York. We've got the winning recipe here, but it all depends on whether or not you join my team today. Hochul thinks she can buy this office again. In 2022, she raised $54 million off the backs of her socialist billionaire donors... the kind of wealthy liberals who can afford to keep illegals, career criminals, and drug dealers out of their neighborhoods. And on top of that, she tried to get her cronies on the New York State Public Campaign Finance Board to deny my campaign over $7 million in matching funds we rightfully earned! Thankfully, the courts reinstated us and shut down her dirty political games. She resorted to these corrupt tactics because the polls prove that New Yorkers are sick of her misery. Now that it failed, imagine just how much more money she will raise over the next three months to buy a victory she doesn't deserve. There's a reason why she and her campaign have been in "panic mode" ever since I announced my candidacy and received the endorsement of President Trump... It's because I will reverse all the damage she's done to New York: I will hire more cops to arrest career criminals and keep them in jail. I will partner with ICE to deport violent illegal aliens who do nothing but drain our resources and harm innocent New Yorkers. I will root out all fraud in our state social programs and prosecute fraudsters and accomplices to the fullest extent of the law. I will protect women and children from "transgender" predators in women's bathrooms and sports. I will end the "Green New Scam" madness and unleash our energy independence to immediately lower your bills. I know this is the winning platform that all New Yorkers desperately need... but we've got to raise enough money to run this race and fight back against Hochul's attacks. With just weeks left until the election, we don't have a minute to waste. That's why it was worth it for me to send you this triple-stamped return envelope today. Any amount you can send today from $5 to $250 get us one step closer to defeating Kathy Hochul once and for all. The average donor gives $35 or $50. Could you give that much today? New Yorkers have never been in a better position to win this race. We are on the cusp of flipping New York and taking back our state. By this time next year, New Yorkers could finally be walking our neighborhoods without fear and paying our bills without scraping by. And we can finally kick this socialist scourge to the curb and stop the Empire State from becoming a socialist nightmare. Help me defeat Kathy Hochul and put New York First. Thank you for joining me. For New York, Bruce Blakeman P.S. Radical Kathy Hochul, Zohran Mamdani, and the rest of the DSA radicals will destroy New York if we give Hochul four more years as Governor. I'm running to defeat her because as a lifelong New Yorker from Long Island, I refuse to let the Empire State be turned into a socialist nightmare. Today I'm counting on you to join my team. Hi Peter - it's Michele.
Wow. The first few weeks since I launched my run for U.S. Senate have been a whirlwind! I've done as many interviews, press events, and TV hits as I possibly could to spread the word about what we're trying to do here:
1\. Clean up the mess that the political class has left us in 2\. Hold our corrupt leaders who sold us out to account 3\. Retake this Minnesota Senate seat in the name of sanity
I hope that plan resonates with you.
Between the hustle and bustle of a new campaign, I just wanted to personally reach out and thank you for your support thus far.

I'm not a politician, and I'll never take your support for granted.
I want you to feel a part of this team - because you are. When we beat the odds and flip this seat, it'll be your victory too.

body:
Thank you for having my back, again and again.
#
Peter:
We're just under one month out from Election Day, and the pressure is on. But not for the reasons you might think...
The truth is: **I don’t want to let you down.**
You are the heart of this campaign. Since the very beginning, grassroots donors have made it possible to compete with massive spending from special interests. You’ve proven that when working people come together, we can win:
* When Peter Thiel dropped $3.6 million against me in a single week, you helped keep our own ads live.
* When JD Vance personally attacked me, you stood by me and helped this campaign surge ahead.
* And when crypto billionaires decided to put $30 million behind new attack ads spreading lies about me, you helped us fight back.

But this race is far from over, Peter.
All eyes are on Ohio, and the money continues to _pour in._ **In fact, Republican megadonors are spending more here than in Georgia, Alaska, and North Carolina combined. Let that sink in.**
I’m not sharing this to scare you – the polls keep proving that we have what it takes to win – but I’m writing this to remind you just how important you are to this movement.
**In the face of a quarter of a BILLION dollars being spent by Republicans in Ohio, our campaign has been able to stay competitive _only_ because of grassroots donations from folks like you. And right now, I need you to have my back more than ever.**
My past races have taught me that this close to Election Day, resources are what allow a candidate to pull ahead. So we cannot give the GOP an inch.
**[Today, I’m asking you to split $15 between my campaign and State Democrats Committee. I’m counting on you.
